{{Quote|Maro Vizhen, head of Special Operations for the Imperial Diplomatic Service.|Maro Vizhen|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Special Operations''' was a division of the [[Imperial Diplomatic Service]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. [[Maro Vizhen]], the head of Special Operations, was tasked with recruiting allies from the criminal syndicates and gangs on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].
